prompt: What is the number of the executive order that created the Federal Theatre Project?
answer: The Federal Theatre Project was created under **Executive Order No. 7034**, signed by President Franklin D. Roosevelt on **May 6, 1935**, which established the Works Progress Administration (WPA). The Theatre Project itself was organized later in 1935 as part of the WPA’s Federal Project Number One.
